correctness.rationale: Path concatenation reduces X²=Z to a_i a_(i+1)=u_i and a_i b_(i+1)+b_i a_(i+2)=v_i with q^n arbitrary length-three coefficients. On the all-nonzero locus the first recurrence yields a single scalar t with even-cycle closure or odd-cycle square equation. The additive recurrence h_i+h_(i+1)=v_i/D_i has invertible cyclic operator only in odd length and odd characteristic, otherwise a one-dimensional kernel and one linear image constraint. Counting scalar roots and P,Q image fibers gives every stated formula and the mass identity. Fresh checker replay matches every enumerated nonzero target in 11 configurations incl. GF(4). These checks are finite support for, not replacements for, the all-field proof.

value.rationale: The principal torus is a natural dense open family of targets in J², with all q,n allowed. Unlike a single small case, its full prescribed-root distribution changes sharply across odd/even n, characteristic two and square classes, quantifying how far the square image is from equidistribution and identifying necessary conditions for extending the complete image calculation beyond the torus. This supplies a motivated nontrivial invariant of an infinite family rather than a routine zero-value count.
